text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Good day, Trainer! It's a lovely morning♪
choice_data_list: Looks like you got some good rest.
Looks like you got some good rest, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I had a great dream today too! I had a 
parade together with all the fairies!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There's a banshee, a dullahan, and a púca!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked up the fairies she mentioned on 
my smartphone... Is it just my 
imagination, or do they all look sinister?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I wonder if it'll come out again~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Although there were a few minor points of 
concern, Fine Motion seems to have gotten 
plenty of rest."
